name: Probopass
description: It is able to emit powerful magnetism, allowing it control over the iron sand that forms its luscious mustache. Using this iron sand, Probopass forms hard stones with which it smites its prey.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Spark
moves.description: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target to deal damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, raising its defensive stats.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description: Large boulders are hurled at the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Tri Attack
moves.description: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also leave the target with a burn, paralysis, or frostbite.

moves.name: Power Gem
moves.description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

moves.name: Flash Cannon
moves.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's defensive stats.
